verdict.rationale: Kick documents an official MCP server, with a quickstart and per-client connector guides for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and custom AI tools. An available-tools page says agents can query transactions, generate reports, create rules, and execute bookkeeping changes with user approval, and the pricing page lists MCP/CLI as a feature. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as documented (all evidence is first-party docs).
